Nina R.: Thanks for a solid all-hands. Capturing a few GTM/partnership follow-ups here so teams can act.
Carlos M.: quick answers: 1) Renewal focus = contracts expiring in 60-120 days with ARR > $30k + churn-risk product signals. 2) Prioritization: partner-led for co-sell ISVs and referral partners where partner provides >50% of pipeline motion. 3) Co-sell support: were adding a "partner play" slot to the AE onboarding and a weekly partner office hour.
Ellen Wu: Ops, which saved view should Sales pull? Also, what fields do you need for the renewal deck?
ops-bot: Daily export scheduled. Use CRM view "renewals_pipeline_60_120". Fields: account_name, ARR, renewal_date, last_product_event, exec_contact, partner_referral.
Carlos M.: Metrics: Marketing tracks influenced pipeline; Revenue ops tracks attributed closed-won for comp. Interim target: increase partner-influenced pipeline by 20% this quarter.
Nina R.: Routing: for now, keep partner-managed until we finish the Q3 pilot; if an opp hits >$200k ARR and needs field coverage, we'll do a joint GTM handoff.
Ellen Wu: PS question: will PoC prioritization change for partner-led deals? last cycle some PoCs deprioritized.
Carlos M.: PS will prioritize partner PoCs where partner is committing resources. We'll publish an SLA doc by Fri.
Nina R.: Action items: ops -> share export and renewal deck template by Mon 10:00 PT; Partnerships -> publish partner play and office hour schedule; PS -> PoC SLA doc by Fri. I'll compile and send to execs.
ops-bot: Reminder: upload renewal deck template to ops drive by Mon 10:00 PT.
Ellen Wu: thanks all 8522
Carlos M.: echoing thanks, will loop in the partner AEs.
